adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a new regular job `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` (app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb) with non-trivial behavior: it raises `Discourse::InvalidParameters` when `args[:embed_url]` is missing, conditionally looks up a `User` by `args[:user_id]`, and passes `no_throttle: user.try(:staff?)` into `TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve`. The added specs cover `TopicRetriever`, `EmbedController`, `PollFeed`, and `TopicEmbed`, but there is no spec file for `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`, so these branches are indeed untested (including the staff no-throttle bypass that affects `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?`). This is a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap rather than a functional defect.
